neighbours.label: setting an example to follow (lead by example, set a good example), and instill
fire: Good parents teach this by leading by example.
Our officers must lead by example in the field.
Trying to set a good example made him a better man.
Children copy a positive example at school.
Coaches should set the example for their players.
What values do you hope to instill in your students?
She always set an example for her younger sisters.
They lead by example in saving energy.
quiet: Good parents teach this by reading to their kids.
Our officers must carry a radio in the field.
Trying to fix a broken fence made him a tired man.
Children copy the alphabet at school.
Here is an example of a verb for their players.
What books do you hope to read to your students?
For example, she always called her younger sisters.
They save money by turning off the energy.

notes: 'an example of a noun' and 'For example' stayed under 0.04 in the probes. Both senses appear in the near misses.
